Triage → `domain:devx` · p2 · **Bug**. Fourth of the five-card author-time-validation family.

**Anchoring — the card names its own landing site and I confirmed it exists on `origin/main` (`66ecc50a`): `packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts`.** That file was in fact my **positive control** for this whole family's routing — an earlier symbol query returned zero across five symbols and only re-running it against this known-present file exposed the zero as a broken pathspec rather than a reading. ⇒ `packages/lint` ⇒ `domain:devx`.

**Type = Bug.** `AppNavigationItemSchema.viewName` is documented as *"Default list view to open. Defaults to 'all'."* — so an unresolvable name **falls back** rather than failing. Declared behaviour (a named view opens) ≠ enforced behaviour (a typo silently opens a different view). The fix narrows the accept set ⇒ ⛔ not a Feature.

**Grade p2.** ⭐ The card's strongest point is the *review-invisibility*: the nav item keeps its authored label and icon, so a "Schedule" entry that opens the plain grid **looks correct in code review**. And the decay mode is worse than the typo mode — renaming a list view silently degrades every nav entry pointing at it, with all four gates green.

⛔ Not p1 all the same: authoring-time, no data loss, no security boundary, and the failure is a wrong-view rather than a broken page.

⭐ **The precedent argument is exact and should anchor the fix.** #2554's `lintViewRefs` exists because *"a `type:'form'` action target naming a missing or LIST view opens a broken form at runtime"* — i.e. the platform already guards **one** door into the `listViews` namespace. Navigation is the other and more-travelled door into the *same* namespace, unguarded. ⇒ this is extending an existing rule to its sibling entry point, ⛔ not a new rule class.

**Scope note — take the card's own hedge seriously.** It asks whether `objectName` resolution is "probably already covered elsewhere; worth confirming". ⇒ that is a **premise to verify before writing code**, not a given. Confirm on the current ref; if it is already covered, the card shrinks to the `viewName` half.

**Stopgap to retire with the fix**: `objectstack-ai/duly`'s `test/views.test.ts` asserts every nav `viewName` resolves, and the reporter wrote it to be deleted when this ships. ⇒ the delivering PR should say whether that deletion is in scope for the downstream repo or is a follow-up there (⛔ do not silently leave a stale stopgap asserting a now-gated invariant).

**Family / fold**: shares `packages/lint/src` with #14105, #14107, #14148 — the lane owes an explicit fold-or-serial answer on the group. This card is the most separable of the four (one file, one recursion over `app.navigation`), so it is the natural candidate to run independently if the group is serialised.

**Dedup**: #2554 (`lintViewRefs`, action-target door) is the precedent, ⛔ not a duplicate — different reference site. #14107 is the field-level layer beneath both. ⛔ No duplicate.

`domain:devx`, session `session_01WLJQhde67SeTccsmnBVarV`, R1 wave 4. PR #14286 MERGED as `a39b02a6` (merge-queue witness: timeline `added_to_merge_queue` @ 00:26:17Z; 34/34 checks on head `43f68b24`, zero red).

**Acceptance probes re-run on `origin/main`:** `view-ref-nav-view-missing` present in `lint-view-refs.ts`, exported from the index, minor changeset present.

Card delivered on the triage anchor exactly (extension of #2554's rule, not a new class), with the premises settled by probe: `objectName` already covered (two live checks with no hole — so the card correctly shrank to the `viewName` half), `runAction` covered, `recordId`/`filters` reasoned out with stated grounds. The card's `'all'` fallback claim was **falsified** rather than trusted — resolution mirrors `resolveViewId` in all three directions, so a name that works at runtime is never reported and no magic-name exemption was hard-coded. Acceptance pinned on `validate` AND `build`; ablation red in exactly the predicted 3 legs; the dev also caught and fixed its own raw-NUL defect mid-task via the binary-grep signal. Downstream stopgap (duly `test/views.test.ts`) named in the PR as a follow-up in that repo.

⭐ **The five-card author-time-validation family is now FULLY LANDED on the lint side + tail**: #14105(`345fc33a`) → #14148(`fa1eca31`) → #14107(`aca23aba`) → #14108(`a39b02a6`), one shared mechanism throughout, zero rework across the four.
